name: charging
description: Integrated safety gate that determines whether charging is allowed based on connection, authentication, battery, temperature, port, emergency, and fault conditions.

requirements.text: Charging may start only when the vehicle is connected, authenticated, battery and temperature are safe, the port is ready, and no emergency or fault is active.
Charging requires the complete safety gate to remain valid.
Emergency or fault conditions must stop charging and force charging power to zero.
Generated charging session code must safely copy vehicle identifiers into fixed-size buffers.
Generated power aggregation checks must expose possible int32 overflow in total charging power.
Generated charging efficiency code must tolerate zero delivered energy during fuzzing.
